profile.headline: Security Engineer/Software Engineer at Trellix
profile.summary: Specialties: Linux, Networking, SQL, JAVA, Information Security, Digital Forensics, Grails, Groovy

positions.title: Security Engineer/Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer with McAfee I work with support and our customers to address bugs and integration issues as well as develop and implement new features..  

As a multi platform developer I work on bugs and features that may be in Java, JavaScript, pascal, Ruby, Perl, C, or in house languages.  

As a web developer I have worked on converting our flash interface to a HTML 5 restful interface using Java, JavaScript, Angular and CSS.

To provide continuous integration and testing support for the product I have used Java, Ruby, EasyMock, PowerMock and other frameworks and libraries to provide unit test, integration tests, and end to end tests to help ensure product quality.

As a Security Engineer I worked with third party products to integrate logging data into our product.  I would use Regular Expressions to parse data out of logs and then normalize that data in our system.  To assist in collection of data and writing rules I would use python and Perl to write scripts to assist.

positions.title: Sr, IT Systems Programmer
positions.description: Design, develop, and maintain web applications. Meet with internal customers and help them determine how custom software can improve their workflow. Work with the customer to gather design requirements. Develop an application to meet the needs of the customer.

positions.title: IT Systems Programmer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and maintain web applications. Meet with internal customers and help them determine how custom software can improve their workflow. Work with the customer to gather design requirements. Develop an application to meet the needs of the customer.

Our stack consisted of Java, Spring, Struts 2, SQL, Hibernate, Groovy, and Grails.  We used jUnit, and Spock for testing.

positions.title: Research and Development
positions.description:
Assist in the development of surveillance products to meet the needs of law enforcement.  Design and test products that minimize the danger to law enforcement during covert operations using some of the latest technologies in GPS tracking, over the air communication, video and audio communication.  

Audit programming of GPS tracking devices to ensure they are preforming at their best to provide up to date information.  Assist in the troubleshooting of defective equipment.

Provide ideas of how to better incorporate technology into everyday law enforcement operations.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant/ Veteran Student Outreach
positions.description:
Helped Military veterans on their path to higher education.  Assisted incoming or potential students in the application processes from questions to paperwork and Major/class selection.  Acted as a mediator between students and professors during difficult times to help veteran students be successful in school.  Counseled with incoming and current veteran students on problems and issues that might arise pertaining to school.

Assisted in collecting and analyzing demographics pertaining to graduate students to help students from recruitment to retention.

Answered questions for incoming students about programs and directed them to the adviser that could best answer questions.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced Java Swing applications connecting to Oracle databases.
Developed and maintained reports using Crystal Reports.  Used SQL to create customized reports for unique situations.

Wrote technical manuals to assist in using custom applications.  Trained employees on the use of custom applications, Crystal Reports and Excel to best leverage data.

positions.title: Security Patrol Officer
positions.description: Patrolled campus to deter crime.  Assisted students, faculty and visitors with safety and security concerns.  Responded to various alarm situations on campus.  Worked with local law enforcement in investigating incidences.  Assisted with evening lock ups and morning unlocking of buildings.

positions.title: Tactical Aircraft Maintenance
positions.description:
Completed routine inspections and aircraft maintenance.  Ensured precision calibration equipment was properly maintained and schedules maintenance when needed.  

Trained and functioned as a Hazardous Materials inspector.

Certified trainer, trained new airmen in job responsibilities and tasks.  Ensured proper maintenance procedures were followed.
